items.informal_name: Infimum degree of an element in the additive monoid algebra
items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  {A : Type u_3} →
    {T : Type u_4} →
      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] → [OrderTop T] → (A → T) → AddMonoidAlgebra R A → T
items.informal_description: For an element $ f $ in the additive monoid algebra $ R[A] $, this function computes the infimum (greatest lower bound) of the degrees of the elements in its support, where the support consists of the non-zero terms of $ f $. The infimum is taken with respect to the degree ordering $ D $ on the additive monoid $ A $, starting from the top element and iteratively combining with the degrees of each term in the support.

items.informal_name: Non-Zero Element Criterion via Supremum Degree Exceeding Bound
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup B] [inst_2 : OrderBot B]
  {D : A → B} [inst_3 : AddZeroClass A] {p : AddMonoidAlgebra R A} {b : B}, ¬AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D p ≤ b → p ≠ 0
items.informal_description: For an element $ p $ in the additive monoid algebra $ R[A] $, if the supremum of the degrees $ D(a) $ for all $ a $ in the support of $ p $ (i.e., elements where $ p $ is non-zero) is strictly greater than $ b $, then $ p $ is not the zero element.

items.informal_name: Vanishing of coefficients outside the supremum degree in additive monoid algebras
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup B] [inst_2 : OrderBot B]
  {D : A → B} {p : AddMonoidAlgebra R A} {a : A}, ¬D a ≤ AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D p → p a = 0
items.informal_description: For any element $ p \in R[A] $ in an additive monoid algebra over a semiring $ R $, and for any $ a \in A $, if the degree $ D(a) $ is not less than or equal to the supremum degree $ \sup\{D(b) \mid b \in \text{supp}(p)\} $ of $ p $, then the coefficient $ p(a) $ is zero. Here, $ \text{supp}(p) $ denotes the support of $ p $, i.e., the set of $ b \in A $ where $ p(b) \neq 0 $.

items.informal_name: Existence of Element in Support Achieving Supremum Degree in Additive Monoid Algebra
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder B] [inst_2 : OrderBot B]
  {p : AddMonoidAlgebra R A} (D : A → B), p ≠ 0 → ∃ a ∈ p.support, AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D p = D a
items.informal_description: For any non-zero element $ p $ in the additive monoid algebra $ R[M] $, there exists an element $ a $ in the support of $ p $ such that the supremum degree $ \sup\{D(a) \mid a \in \text{support}(p)\} $ is equal to $ D(a) $, where $ D $ is a degree function on the additive monoid $ M $.

items.informal_name: Non-zero Element Criterion via Supremum Degree
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup B] [inst_2 : OrderBot B]
  {D : A → B} [inst_3 : AddZeroClass A] {p : AddMonoidAlgebra R A}, AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D p ≠ ⊥ → p ≠ 0
items.informal_description: If the supremum of the degrees of the support of an element $ p $ in an additive monoid algebra is not equal to the bottom element $ \bot $, then $ p $ is not the zero element, i.e., $ p \neq 0 $.

items.informal_name: Supremum Degree of Non-Zero Element in Additive Monoid Algebra is in the Image of the Degree Function
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder B] [inst_2 : OrderBot B]
  {p : AddMonoidAlgebra R A} (D : A → B), p ≠ 0 → AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D p ∈ Set.range D
items.informal_description: For any non-zero element $ p $ in the additive monoid algebra $ R[M] $, the supremum of the degrees $ D(a) $ for all $ a $ in the support of $ p $ is contained in the image of the degree function $ D $, i.e., $ \sup_{a \in \text{supp}(p)} D(a) \in D(M) $.

items.informal_name: Supremum Degree Element is in Support
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder B] [inst_2 : OrderBot B]
  {p : AddMonoidAlgebra R A} {D : A → B} [inst_3 : AddZeroClass A],
  Function.Injective D → p ≠ 0 → Function.invFun D (AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D p) ∈ p.support
items.informal_description: For a non-zero element $ p $ in the additive monoid algebra $ R[A] $, if the degree function $ D : A \to \alpha $ is injective, then the unique element $ a \in A $ satisfying $ D(a) = \sup\{D(a) \mid a \in \text{support}(p)\} $ belongs to the support of $ p $.

items.informal_name: Weight of Non-Zero Element is Less Than or Equal to Total Weight
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M]
  [CanonicallyOrderedAdd M] (w : σ → M) {s : σ} {f : σ →₀ ℕ}, f s ≠ 0 → w s ≤ (Finsupp.weight w) f
items.informal_description: For any element $s$ in $\sigma$ and finite support function $f : \sigma \to_0 \mathbb{N}$, if $f(s) \neq 0$, then the weight $w(s)$ of $s$ is less than or equal to the total weight $\text{weight}_w(f)$ of $f$, where $\text{weight}_w(f) = \sum_{s \in \text{support}(f)} f(s) \cdot w(s)$.
